scope.description: Whole epubcheck application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: EPUB package/document validation, profiles, severity and message configuration, archive/expanded-folder input and structured reporting.

coverage.rationale: The central package-validation workflow is present, but profile/custom-message handling, tolerant reporting and expanded inputs are excluded.

scope.description: Strict zero-finding validation of one captured finished EPUB using the fixed default profile.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: A publication pass/fail goal and captured input replace Java flags and report parsing; the decision remains a fixed policy rather than adaptable editorial intent.

limitations: Exactly the recorded supported EPUBCheck release and default profile; any warning fails; no repair, rendering, accessibility or legal certification.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
